kpis.explanation: Revenue from media rights fees for content distribution
kpis.description: Revenus generés par la distribution de contenu médias et les droits de diffusion pour UFC, WWE et autres segments

kpis.explanation: Revenue from ticket sales, site fees and hospitality at live events
kpis.description: Revenus provenant de la vente de billets, des frais de site et des services d'hospitalité pour les événements en direct UFC, WWE et autres propriétés

risks.title: Media rights dependency
risks.score_rationale: TKO depends heavily on media rights fees for revenue generation, which can be affected by changes in the media landscape and broadcaster preferences
risks.summary: The company is exposed to risks related to media rights concentration, as this is a primary revenue source across all business segments

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The sports and entertainment market is highly competitive, which may affect the company's ability to maintain market share and secure favorable media rights deals
risks.summary: Increased competition in the sports and entertainment market could have a negative impact on TKO's ability to grow revenue and maintain brand prominence

risks.title: Talent and athlete risks
risks.score_rationale: TKO depends on key athletes and talent to generate revenue, which can be affected by injuries, departures or career changes
risks.summary: The company is exposed to risks related to athlete health, availability and retention, which could impact revenues and brand reputation

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: TKO is subject to government regulations and laws that may change, affecting business operations and event permitting
risks.summary: The company is exposed to regulatory risks across multiple jurisdictions that could impact operations, event hosting and content distribution

risks.title: Reputation and brand risks
risks.score_rationale: TKO is exposed to reputation risks through athlete conduct, safety incidents, and negative events that could affect brand value and revenue
risks.summary: The company's brand and revenue are vulnerable to negative events, controversies, or safety incidents involving athletes or events

risks.title: Financial and debt risks
risks.score_rationale: TKO has debt and financial obligations that may be affected by market conditions, interest rate changes, and refinancing requirements
risks.summary: The company is exposed to financial risks including debt service obligations and refinancing needs that could impact financial stability
